name: Claude-Melusina
shortDescription: A self-contained Claude Code workspace, streamed to the browser.
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Claude-Melusina ships Claude Code, its loader, and its exact shared-library closure in the signed package. A grain has no network, so one PowerBox HTTP-out capability grants api.anthropic.com through a loopback proxy. After that, users sign in through Claude Code’s browser-link flow; this app never requests an API key. Its governed DiagnosticProbe v1 can only validate an exact target package through read-only contract and health methods; it is not a generic Pearl connector. /var holds only the persistent workspace and Claude Code’s own login/session state.
